Method of Attack: Mass scanning of random IP addresses on port 8291 to identify MikroTik devices
Exploitation of Chimay Red vulnerability in MikroTik RouterOS firmware 6.38.4 and earlier to execute code and take over devices
Infection via public exploit packages sent through ports 80, 81, 82, 8080, 8081, 8082, 8089, 8181, and 8880
Infected devices then scan and infect other MikroTik routers
Impacted Systems: MikroTik RouterOS devices with firmware version 6.38.4 and earlier
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Chimay Red vulnerability in RouterOS firmware
Use of multiple HTTP and related ports for exploit delivery
Indicators of Compromise: Hostname changes on MikroTik devices including the word 'hacked'
